What the station does, and why it does it this way.

Thirteen tones crossed with twenty seals: 260 combinations that loop back on themselves. The count follows neither sun nor moon — it does not date, it situates. Your KIN comes out of that grid, and it is on that grid that the station measures what brings you close to someone.

A tone, 1 to 13, crossed with a seal, 1 to 20: your KIN is one of the 260 cells of the Tzolkin. The seal wraps around — past the twentieth you are back at the first — so two KIN far apart by number can be neighbours by seal. Your date of birth is enough to compute it: this station does so itself, and you read it under "Singularity · computed". An Astroport.ONE station returns the same number with your MULTIPASS.
The Φ wave, the Octave wave

Two polarities, and nothing else: Φ or Octave. It goes into your key exactly as it stands, and says which side of the interference you vibrate on. Your frequency does not follow from it: that one needs your height and your weight — it is the biological wave, just below.

It is the frequency of the water you carry. The station first works out that water from your height and today\'s weight — Watson\'s formula, two equations depending on polarity — then brings it back to a frequency in hertz, on a basis of 429.62 Hz for a body holding 70 kg of water. Neither height nor weight enters your key: they change with you, a key does not. Without them there is no biological wave at all — which is why the record asks for them again.

ATOM4LOVE is not astrology. At the exact moment of your birth, the Earth held a precise position in space-time. You carry its geometric imprint — and it can be computed, to the minute and to the degree.
Picture your body as an instrument. Your place and date of birth set the note you play at all times: your personal phase. Your polarity says which side of the interference that note sits on.

Meeting someone is crossing two phases. If they fit together, that is super-coherence: you understand each other without speaking. If they clash, that is creative friction: you are made to invent together. Neither is a score, and neither is better than the other.

Your conception is Spirit, your birth is Matter. Combining them, the station computes your archetype — the way you transform the energy around you. You do not need to know that date: it follows from your birth.

On first launch, the station forges a key of its own, derived from your birth data. It is enough for everything that happens within antenna range: the radar, the booth, proximity links. It is temporary — one day an Astroport.ONE station will derive your real LOVE key.

It is your decentralised identity on the UPlanet network: a published NOSTR key, a Ğ1 / Ẑen wallet, a storage space, and your LOVE key. It opens from the bottom of the Nucleus tab, with an email address. UPlanet ORIGIN, where you land, is a sandbox: a Ẑen is worth 0.1 Ğ1 there, and an account left at zero without movement is deleted after seven days.

Fill in the incarnation form: the “To fill in” line tells you what is missing. For the place, type three letters and pick your town from the list, or tap 📍 to use your position. Before forging, a summary asks you to read it over one last time: after confirmation, nothing can be changed.

There is no recovery phrase to write down: those close to you already know it. Anyone who knows where and when you were born can tell you your birth data back — and the same key will be reborn, on any station. Your place of birth counts to within 1 km: note it carefully, it is what reopens your LOVE key if you lose this device. The account itself, on the other hand, is recovered with the PASS code sent by mail.
Wrong data? In the Nucleus tab, “Dissolve the nucleus” erases the form and this station\'s key (two confirmations). Nothing goes onto the network: enter the right data and forge again.

🌀 Radar: the booths within range, by real proximity. 🎴 Board: your cards. 💜 Resonance: your bonds. ⚛ Nucleus: your sealed form and your npub. At the top, “relay · x / y” says how many NOSTR relays answer — green as soon as the station is on the network.
The questions that keep coming back, and what the station answers.
Do I need an Internet connection?

Not for the cabin: it speaks over Bluetooth, or over a Wi-Fi network it builds itself between the two devices. Nothing passes through a server. The rest of the station — the NOSTR relays, the MULTIPASS — does need the network, and you can see it in the “relay · x / y” at the top of the screen.
What is said in the cabin, where does it go?

Nowhere else. The content is end-to-end encrypted and crosses no relay. On closing the cabin, the conversation and the attachments you received are wiped from the device — that is what “touch to close and erase” promises, and it keeps it.
Why two weights: my birth weight and today\'s?

They do not serve the same purpose. Birth weight enters your key, together with polarity: it is optional, and without it the station keeps 3.5 kg — exactly what Astroport.ONE does when that field arrives empty. Your height and weight today enter no key at all: they give your biological wave, and you can correct them whenever you like.
Bluetooth must be on at both ends, and the other person must have opened their cabin: you only see cores whose cabin is open. Until someone makes that gesture, nothing announces itself — by design.
Can I correct my data after forging?

Not directly: once confirmed, the record is sealed. In the Core tab, “Dissolve the core” erases this station\'s record and key, and you forge again with the right data. Your key depends on that data: the smallest correction yields a different one.
Made In Zion: what makes the station work, in the words of those who wrote it.
How your birth calibrates a secret address on Earth — and lets you find each other without revealing who you are.

The Earth\'s surface is cut into 12 pentagons — the vertices of the icosahedron — surrounded by thousands of hexagons, like a football projected onto the globe. Each hexagon covers 1 to 50 km² depending on the resolution.
Your date, time and place of birth define an angle φᵢ ∈ [0, 2π) within the sidereal year. That is your celestial imprint: immutable, computed on the device, with no database at all.

The grid turns continuously at the speed of the golden ratio φ — one full revolution every 14 h 50. The same GPS coordinates yield a different address from one hour to the next: without the exact instant, a relay scraper cannot recover the position.

Two people who know their phases φ compute the meeting hexagon and its geometric centre. No server knows the place. Physical presence is proved by the Cabin-33 ritual: 33 seconds still, within 50 m of the centre.
Path of trust — from birth to the meeting

The a4l: address published in a NOSTR event reveals no GPS position. Without the golden precession formula and the event\'s exact timestamp, the hexagonal coordinates cannot be turned into latitude and longitude.
Two people who exchange their phases φ compute their shared hexagon and confirm presence through Cabin-33, with no intermediary. Resonance k is computed on each device.

The 33-second ritual is accompanied by a binaural tone at 429.62 Hz + 33.17 Hz. The constant F_Φ = 33.17 Hz is the very one that enters the calculation of your phase: body and place become coherent on the same number.
Your birth number in the galactic calendar — a 260-day compass for coordinating meetings without a recommendation algorithm.

The Tzolkin crosses 20 seals — archetypes — with 13 tones — energy levels: 260 Kin. Everyone is born on one precise day of that cycle, and their Kin stays their galactic imprint for life. The 52-year cycle, the Calendar Round, is the mathematical intersection of 260 and 365.

Each Kin generates five correspondences: the Guide (natural mentor), the Antipode (creative challenge), the Analogue (complement of the same tone), the Occult (hidden partner, K + K\' = 261) and the Self. These five powers form the Oracle of the Kin.
A number from 1 to 260. No doctrine, no dogma — a mathematical structure independent of any culture and any calendar.
Analogue, Guide, Antipode, Occult: four kinds of relation defined mathematically from birth. No behavioural tracking.
🔒 Combined with φᵢ: a double filter
The Mayan Kin says who to meet structurally, the phase φ says how strongly it resonates. Together they rule out meeting at random.

260 days is roughly 9 × 28 days: a rhythm close to the lunar cycle, and distinct from the some 270 days of gestation used by the conception calculation. A calendar written into biology, not into a social convention.
🎵 The tone, a part in the orchestra
T1, Magnetic: the steady foundation. T7, Resonant: the catalysing pivot. T13, Cosmic: the rhythmic drive. The Tzolkin assigns a natural part within any collective.
The body as a water antenna
429.62 Hz: the resonance frequency of water. The body — 70 % water, proportions in φ — is a biological antenna tuned by gesture and by sound.
💧 The body as a water antenna

Marc Henry measured water resonating at 429.62 Hz — a frequency neither tempered nor arbitrary, derived from the constants of liquid water. The human body, 70 % water, is therefore a natural resonator; the golden-ratio proportions of the phalanges and the hand form a geometric antenna able to receive that signal and to emit it.
✋ Mudras — five fingers, five elements, five powers

In the Vedic Pancha Mahabhuta, each finger takes in a primordial element. And the five Oracle powers of the Mayan Kin follow the same fivefold structure: the hand becomes the living gesture of the galactic calendar, a mudra tuned to the element of the moment.
Cabin-33 binaural spectrum — tuning to the frequency of water

Marc Henry measured liquid water entering maximum resonance at this frequency: neither the 440 Hz A of equal temperament, nor the esoteric “432 Hz”, but a measurable physical constant. The whole body, like water, vibrates on that carrier.

The galactic tone of your Kin — from T1, Magnetic, to T13, Cosmic — sets your rhythm in the cooperative orchestra, and the matching mudra anchors it in the body. T7, Resonant, calls for the Vayu mudra: the index finger, Air, maximum vibration within the collective.

At the geometric centre of a hexagon, 33 seconds still, the binaural tone — 429.62 Hz on the left, 462.79 Hz on the right — creates a 33.17 Hz beat in the brain: F_Φ. That beat synchronises the body\'s antenna with the hexagonal node; it is a biological proof of presence.
Four nested cryptographic functions — the same ones in the browser, in Ẑelkova and in this application.
From the birth record to the two keys
The salt and the pepper of your record are stretched separately, 600,000 rounds each, over the domain “uplanet-a4l-v1”. Out come a stretched salt and a stretched pepper.
The stretched pepper goes through scrypt — N = 4096, r = 16, p = 1 — with the stretched salt as its salt. Out comes a 32-byte seed, shared by both keys.
The private key is the SHA-256 of the seed; the public key follows from it on the secp256k1 curve. Both are written in bech32, per NIP-19: nsec and npub.
The same seed generates an Ed25519 pair. The public key, in Base58, gives the 44-character G1 address that Cesium reads — the free currency, on the Duniter v2 chain.
